content:
Alexa M: Hey folks — opened a small cleanup PR that reorganizes a few GraphQL resolver files and normalizes export patterns. Mostly style/modularization, but it touches resolver imports so I'd love 2 quick pairs of :eyes: before merge. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/4821 branch: chore/refactor-resolvers-style. Files: resolver split (user/order), updated barrel exports, a couple lint fixes. No intended behavior changes.

Mike L: Can someone check the public API shape? @Priya K I think you own the plugin surface that uses these exports — can you verify nothing breaks?

Priya K: Looking now. Quick Q — I noticed `getUserData` moved from `resolvers/index.ts` to `core/helpers.ts` and the index no longer re-exports it. Do plugins still import from the same path?

Alexa M: Thanks — I moved it to core/helpers to reduce circular deps and added a re-export from the barrel. Forgot to push that in the original commit, pushing fix now.

CI Bot: ci/checks — lint step failed on PR 4821
```
/src/graphql/resolvers/index.ts: line 12: 'unused-import' no-unused-vars
```

Alexa M: pushed re-export and removed the unused import, rerunning CI.

CI Bot: ci/checks — All checks passed for PR 4821 ✅

Jordan S: I'll take a second pass for style and test flakiness. If green I'll approve.

Mike L: One naming nit: other resolver files use `*.resolvers.ts` suffix (e.g., product.resolvers.ts). Can we rename `userResolvers.ts` -> `users.resolvers.ts` for consistency? Small change but helps scanning.

Alexa M: Good call, renamed and pushed.

Priya K: Re-checked plugin imports — looks good now, re-exports preserved. No runtime changes observed in local smoke tests.

Jordan S: Ran tests locally, everything passes; small comment on a line-length lint rule but adjustable. LGTM aside from that nit.

Alexa M: Addressed the line-length nit (wrapped long template). Pushed final. Anyone want to take merge or should I go ahead after local merge? :shrug:

Mike L: If CI is green and Jordan approved, go ahead and merge. Thanks for cleaning this up. :thumbsup:

Jordan S: Approved and ready. :shipit:
